## Which file do I need?

| Browser | Download | Install |
|---|---|---|
| Chrome, Brave | `preflight-VERSION-chrome.zip` | Unzip, open `chrome://extensions` (or `brave://extensions`), turn on **Developer mode**, **Load unpacked**, pick the folder |
| Edge | `preflight-VERSION-edge.zip` | Unzip, open `edge://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, **Load unpacked**, pick the folder |
| Firefox | `preflight-VERSION-firefox.zip` | Unzip, open `about:debugging` → This Firefox → **Load Temporary Add-on**, pick `manifest.json` (removed when Firefox restarts) |
| Claude Code | `preflight-hook.mjs` | See [In Claude Code](https://github.com/shashwatgoyal-codes/askwell#in-claude-code) in the README |

`preflight-VERSION-sources.zip` is the source code, for store reviewers. Safari is not supported yet.
